title: Score de référence endoscopique de l'œsophagite à éosinophiles (EREFS)
formula:
The EREFS is calculated by the addition of the following:

| Feature | Scoring | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E dema | 0 = Absent 1 = Present | Loss of normal vascular markings; pallor or decreased transparency |
| R ings | 0 = None 1 = Mild (subtle) 2 = Moderate 3 = Severe (fixed rings) | Trachealization/feline esophagus; concentric esophageal rings |
| E xudates | 0 = None 1 = Mild (≤10% mucosal surface) 2 = Severe (>10%) | White plaques on mucosa |
| F urrows | 0 = Absent 1 = Present | Vertical lines or creases along the esophageal wall |
| S trictures | 0 = None 1 = Present | Fixed narrowings requiring small-caliber scope or causing resistance |

how_to_use.why:
- Fournit une nomenclature standardisée pour caractériser la gravité de l'EoE.
- Éclaire les décisions de prise en charge telles que l'escalade thérapeutique, les intervalles de maintenance et la nécessité d'une dilatation.
- Permet de suivre objectivement la réponse thérapeutique au traitement de l'EoE.
- Endossé pour le compte rendu en routine dans les recommandations actuelles de l'American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy (ASGE) et de l'American College of Gastroenterology (ACG) sur l'EoE.
how_to_use.when: Appliquer lors de l'endoscopie digestive haute initiale chez l'adulte et l'enfant en cas de suspicion d'œsophagite à éosinophiles (EoE) et à chaque endoscopie de suivi pour définir et surveiller l'activité de la maladie.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Built around the five hallmark endoscopic features of EoE.
- Pooled sensitivity and specificity approach 90% in identifying EoE in adult and pediatric cohorts when a composite score of ≥2 is used, with AUROC 0.79–0.94 across validation studies.
- Does not capture histology or symptoms; combine with biopsy and patient-reported outcomes for a full assessment.
- An inflammatory subscore (edema, exudates, furrows) correlates strongly with peak eosinophil density on biopsy.
- Fibrostenotic findings (rings/strictures) may persist despite inflammatory improvement.

next_steps.advice:
- Always interpret the results of this tool together with symptom severity and biopsy results to capture the full spectrum of EoE activity and therapeutic response.
- Successful treatment should drive down the inflammatory subscores (edema, exudates, furrows); therapy options include:

 - Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs).
 - Topical corticosteroids (e.g., budesonide, fluticasone).
 - Biologic therapy (e.g., dupilumab).
 - Dietary modifications.
- Fibrostenotic features (rings, strictures) seldom regress with medication alone; plan endoscopic dilation when dysphagia or food-impaction risk persists despite adequate anti-inflammatory therapy.
- Repeat upper endoscopy with EREFS calculation about 6–12 weeks after starting or escalating treatment, after any de-escalation, and at clinically driven intervals (typically every 12–24 months) to verify and maintain remission.

more_info: Interprétation : Un score plus élevé indique une maladie plus grave.
medium_description: Evaluates gravité de endoscopic findings chez les patients avec eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE).

input_schema.name: edema
input_schema.label: **E** dema
input_schema.tips: Abolition des marques vasculaires normales ; pâleur ou diminution de la transparence

input_schema.name: furrows
input_schema.label: **F** urrows
input_schema.tips: Lignes ou plis verticaux le long de la paroi œsophagienne

input_schema.name: strictures
input_schema.label: **S** trictures
input_schema.tips: Sténoses fixes nécessitant un endoscope de petit calibre ou entraînant une résistance
